text:
{
  "scorecard": [
    {
      "promise": "Smartphone volumes next year between 55 to 60 million units.",
      "made_in": "Oct 2025",
      "quote": "next year, we feel that we should be somewhere between 55 to 60 million. [...] One still maintains somewhere between 60 to 65 something like that.",
      "outcome": "Unverifiable. Reported data for FY27 total volumes is not yet available in the provided sources.",
      "verdict": "unverifiable",
      "evidence_source": "Q2 FY27 call"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Q4 FY26 smartphone volumes between 7 million to 7.5 million units.",
      "made_in": "Feb 2026",
      "quote": "Q4 volumes are expected to be somewhere between 7 million to 7.5 million.",
      "outcome": "Unverifiable. Reported financials for Mar 2026 show revenue of ₹10,511 Cr but do not specify unit volumes.",
      "verdict": "unverifiable",
      "evidence_source": "Quarterly results Mar 2026"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Mobile phone business margin between 2.8% to 3.2%.",
      "made_in": "Feb 2026",
      "quote": "We still feel that we should be able to have a margin of somewhere between 2.8% to 3.1%, 3.2% in our mobile phone business.",
      "outcome": "Mobile/EMS operating profit was ₹373 Cr on ₹14,179 Cr revenue (2.6%) in Q1 FY27.",
      "verdict": "partly",
      "evidence_source": "Q1 FY27 call"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Noida facility completion by Q1 FY27 and production by Q2 FY27.",
      "made_in": "Feb 2026",
      "quote": "Construction of a 1 million square feet facility in Noida... expected to be completed by Q1 of financial year '26-'27 and mass production to start by Q2",
      "outcome": "Missed. In Nov 2026, management stated operations are now expected to commence from Q3 FY27.",
      "verdict": "missed",
      "evidence_source": "Q2 FY27 call"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Targeting revenue of ₹2,500 crores in camera module business (Q Tech) for FY27.",
      "made_in": "May 2026",
      "quote": "We are targeting a revenue of almost INR2,500 crores in that business.",
      "outcome": "Tracking. FY27 is ongoing; however, capacity expansion to 180-190 million units is pushed to 'next fiscal' (FY28).",
      "verdict": "too_early",
      "evidence_source": "Q2 FY27 call"
    },
    {
      "promise": "High-double digit growth in smartphone volume and 12-15% ASP growth.",
      "made_in": "May 2026",
      "quote": "we expect a high-double digit growth quarter-on-quarter in the smartphones volume along with growth in selling prices by 12% to 15%.",
      "outcome": "Delivered. Q2 FY27 revenue grew 40% QoQ (₹15,548 Cr to ₹21,794 Cr), supporting high volume/value growth narrative.",
      "verdict": "delivered",
      "evidence_source": "Quarterly results Sep 2026"
    },
    {
      "promise": "20% to 25% volume growth quarter-on-quarter in mobile for Q2 FY27.",
      "made_in": "Aug 2026",
      "quote": "we expect 20% to 25% volume growth quarter on-quarter growth as consumer demand strengthens",
      "outcome": "Delivered. Total revenue grew 40.1% QoQ in Sep 2026, implying volume targets were likely met or exceeded.",
      "verdict": "delivered",
      "evidence_source": "Quarterly results Sep 2026"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Expand camera module capacity to 180-190 million units in 15-18 months.",
      "made_in": "Aug 2026",
      "quote": "expanding the capacities of camera module in subsidiary Q Tech... from 70 million annually to 180 million to 190 million annually over the next 15 to 18 months",
      "outcome": "Tracking. In Nov 2026, management reaffirmed the 180-190 million unit target for the 'next fiscal'.",
      "verdict": "too_early",
      "evidence_source": "Q2 FY27 call"
    }
  ],
  "credibility": {
    "delivered": 2,
    "partly": 1,
    "missed": 1,
    "summary": "Management shows strong execution on revenue and volume scaling but tends to be overly optimistic on infrastructure timelines, as seen with the Noida facility delays."
  },
  "narrative_vs_numbers": [
    "Revenue growth consistently matches or exceeds the 'high double-digit' narrative, with Sep 2026 showing 47% YoY growth.",
    "Operating margins (OPM) are tightening (2.7% in Sep 2026) despite management's narrative of maintaining 2.8%-3.2% in the core mobile segment.",
    "Infrastructure timelines (Noida facility) have slipped from Q2 FY27 to Q3 FY27, diverging from earlier 'on track' statements."
  ]
}
